title: About AvaLimo Houston | Licensed Chauffeur Service
description: AvaLimo Houston is a licensed Texas chauffeur and limousine company serving Greater Houston since 2008. Meet the team behind your airport transfer.
body:
AvaLimo Houston is a locally owned luxury chauffeur and limousine company serving Greater Houston, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Katy, The Woodlands and Galveston. We have provided airport transfers, corporate travel, wedding transportation and cruise port transfers since 2008.

What we do

Our service is built around flat-rate quotes, professional chauffeurs and a fleet that stays comfortable in Houston: the Mercedes-Benz S-Class for executive and airport travel, the Cadillac Escalade for families and groups, and the Mercedes Sprinter for larger parties. Every reservation is dispatched by a human, and every chauffeur is licensed, background checked and insured.

Ava Limo Luxury Transportation LLC is registered in Texas and based in Missouri City, TX 77459.

How we work

  • We track commercial and private flights so a delayed arrival does not cost you your ride.
  • We quote flat rates before you book — no surge pricing, no meter, no surprises.
  • We answer the phone 24/7, 365 days a year.
  • We do not sell your personal data, and we say so in our privacy policy.

Contact

Call (832) 567-8050 for dispatch, or email adam@avalimo.net. You can also read our customer reviews or book online.

Serving Houston, IAH, Hobby Airport, Sugar Land, Katy, The Woodlands, Galveston and city-to-city routes across Texas.

Booking

You can request a reservation online. A dispatcher confirms availability and your chauffeur before the ride.

What We Need to Book Your Ride

Pickup address, drop-off address, date and pickup time — plus your flight number for airport pickups, how many passengers and bags you have, and whether you need a child seat. With that, dispatch confirms your chauffeur and vehicle right away.

Airport Pickups at IAH & Hobby

We track your flight in real time and meet you at baggage claim with a name sign, or curbside when you are ready — whichever you prefer. Flat rates cover meet & greet, wait time, tolls and airport parking.

Corporate Accounts

Companies across Houston use AvaLimo for executive airport runs, roadshows and client pickups. Email adam@avalimo.net to open a corporate account with monthly itemized billing.

Long-Distance Rides

Beyond Greater Houston, we run flat-rate private rides from Victoria ($600 to IAH, Hobby or Downtown Houston) and Wharton ($350 to Houston airports or downtown), plus city-to-city trips across Texas — quoted before you book and guaranteed when you ride.

title: Privacy Policy | AvaLimo Houston
description: How AvaLimo Houston collects, uses and protects the information you share when you request a chauffeured ride. We do not sell personal data.
body:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

This policy explains what information Ava Limo Luxury Transportation LLC ("AvaLimo", "we") collects when you visit avalimo.net or request a ride, and how we use it.

What we collect

  • Reservation details — name, phone number, email, pickup and drop-off addresses, date and time, flight number and any notes you add to the booking request.
  • Communication — messages you send us by phone, WhatsApp, email or the booking form.
  • Usage data — aggregated page views, referrers and device type collected by our analytics tools (Google Analytics and datafa.st).
  • Voice concierge — if you use the optional voice assistant, your microphone audio is streamed to our voice provider for the duration of the call. We do not record it ourselves.

How we use it

We use reservation details to quote, dispatch and complete your ride, to contact you about your booking, and to keep the records a licensed transportation operator needs. We use analytics to understand which pages are useful. We do not sell or rent personal information.

Who we share it with

Only the people and processors needed to provide the ride: our dispatchers and chauffeurs, our booking automation and email/SMS providers, and our analytics providers. We may disclose information when the law requires it.

Cookies

The site uses cookies for analytics and to remember your preferences. You can block cookies in your browser; the booking form still works.

Retention

We keep reservation records for the period required for tax, insurance and licensing purposes, then delete or anonymise them.

Your choices

You can ask us for a copy of your information, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to messages by emailing adam@avalimo.net. We respond within 30 days.

Contact

Ava Limo Luxury Transportation LLC, Missouri City, TX 77459 · (832) 567-8050 · adam@avalimo.net

title: Terms of Service | AvaLimo Houston
description: Terms for booking a chauffeur or limousine with AvaLimo Houston: reservation requests, pricing, cancellation, waiting time, conduct and liability.
body:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

These terms apply to rides booked from avalimo.net and to all transportation provided by Ava Limo Luxury Transportation LLC ("AvaLimo").

Reservations

A request submitted through this website is a reservation request, not a confirmed booking. A ride is confirmed when a dispatcher confirms availability and the chauffeur assignment, by phone, email or text.

Pricing

Quoted flat rates cover the route described in your quote. Waiting time, additional stops, cleaning fees, tolls where not included, and airport parking are extra unless your quote says otherwise.

Cancellation and waiting time

Cancellation terms are confirmed with your reservation. As a guide: airport pickups include 60 minutes of complimentary waiting from landing and other pickups 15 minutes; after that, waiting is charged at the hourly rate. Cancellations inside the notice period in your confirmation may be charged in full.

Conduct and safety

Chauffeurs follow traffic law and may refuse a ride, or end it, if a passenger behaves unsafely or illegally. No smoking, vaping or illegal substances in the vehicles. Damage caused by a passenger is chargeable.

Liability

We carry commercial insurance and operate as a licensed Texas transportation provider. Our liability is limited to the value of the transportation service, to the extent the law allows. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

Changes

We may update these terms; the date above is the current version. Questions: adam@avalimo.net or (832) 567-8050.
